question: How are NYC crashes distributed across the days of the week, 2013 to 2025?
population: All rows representing police-reported NYC crashes whose crash_date falls from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31, inclusive
filters: Include crash_date years 2013 through 2025 inclusive; exclude rows with a missing crash_date and dates outside this interval
grouping: Day of week derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday

data_check.date_quality: 0 missing crash_date values; 0 sentinel/default dates in scope; 0 missing or invalid derived weekdays.
data_check.year_coverage: Every year from 2013 through 2025 has rows, with observed dates from January 1 through December 31; this endpoint check does not establish reporting completeness within each year.
data_check.excluded_rows: 100545 rows dated before 2013-01-01 and 36424 rows dated after 2025-12-31 are excluded; no source rows have a missing crash_date.
data_check.decision: Keep every in-range row. Exclude the 137969 dated rows outside the requested period. No rows are dropped for missing or invalid weekday values. The population therefore counts in-range police-reported crash records.

plan_changes: None; the date and derived weekday checks did not require a change to the initial plan.
limitations: This is a count of police-reported crashes, not an exposure-adjusted crash risk. Pooling all 13 years can conceal year-to-year changes, and observed date endpoints alone do not prove complete reporting throughout each year.
